intents.definition: The user wants to find or manage their API credentials such as merchant_id, api_key and crc_key.
examples: Where do I find my merchant_id and api_key?
Gdzie w panelu jest crc_key?
Gdzie sa moje klucze API do integracji?
Nie moge nigdzie znalezc identyfikatora sprzedawcy
Potrzebuje danych do podpisu, ale nie wiem skad je wziac
How do I regenerate my API key if I want a new one?
Ej, gdzie sie klika te klucze, szukam od pol godziny
not: My signature is invalid, how do I fix it? (api_signature_error)
My api_key leaked, what now? (security_key_leak)

intents.definition: The user is getting an invalid signature error and wants to understand how to compute or fix it.
examples: I keep getting 'invalid signature' on every request
Jak poprawnie policzyc podpis SHA-384?
Blad podpisu, co robie zle?
Moja integracja zwraca ciagle signature mismatch
The hash I send never matches yours, what fields go into it?

not: Where do I get the crc_key used in the signature? (api_keys_where)
What does error code 400 mean? (api_errors_limits)

intents.definition: The user wants to configure webhooks, understand retries, confirmations or the IP allowlist.
examples: How do I set up a webhook URL for payment confirmations?
Jak dziala ponawianie webhookow jesli moj serwer nie odpowie?
Z jakich IP przychodza wasze powiadomienia? Chce dodac do allowlisty
Nie dostaje potwierdzen platnosci na moj endpoint
Do you retry the notification if I return a 500?
Ustawilem notyfikacje ale nic nie przychodzi
Panie, te wasze callbacki w ogole do mnie nie leca, pomocy
not: How do I register a transaction via API? (api_transaction_flow)
What is the rate limit for the API? (api_errors_limits)

intents.definition: The user wants to understand how to register and verify transactions through the API session flow.
examples: What's the correct order of API calls to start a payment?
Jak zarejestrowac transakcje i potem ja zweryfikowac?
Jak sprawdzic status platnosci po stronie API?
Nie wiem jak przekierowac klienta do bramki po utworzeniu sesji

Ogarnijcie mnie prosze, kompletnie sie gubie w tym flow platnosci
not: How do webhooks confirm the payment? (webhook_setup_retry)
Which plugin should I use for WooCommerce? (plugin_setup)

intents.definition: The user wants to install or configure a ready-made plugin, widget or SDK for their platform.
examples: How do I install the WooCommerce plugin?
Macie wtyczke do PrestaShop?
Czy jest integracja pod Shopify?
Zainstalowalem modul do Magento ale przycisk platnosci sie nie pokazuje

not: What is the correct API call sequence? (api_transaction_flow)
Where are my API keys? (api_keys_where)

intents.definition: The user wants to understand API error codes, rate limits or the difference between sandbox and production environments.
examples: What does error code 429 mean?
Jaki jest limit zapytan na minute?
Ile requestow na minute moge wyslac?

Testuje na sandboxie, jak przelaczyc sie na produkcje?
Ciagle mnie wywala 429, co jest grane z tymi limitami?
not: My signature is invalid (api_signature_error)
Where do I set up the webhook IP allowlist? (webhook_setup_retry)

intents.definition: The user wants to know how to register as a merchant and what verification documents are required.
examples: How do I sign up as a merchant?
Jakie dokumenty sa potrzebne do weryfikacji firmy?
Jak zalozyc konto sprzedawcy?

What do you need for KYC, just the company registration?
Mam jednoosobowa dzialalnosc, jak przejsc weryfikacje?
No dobra, chce sie zapisac, gdzie klikam zeby zalozyc konto?

How do I add a colleague to my account? (account_roles_team)

intents.definition: The user wants to know how long verification or account activation takes.
examples: How long does the verification take?
Ile czasu trwa aktywacja konta?
Po ilu dniach konto bedzie aktywne?
Zlozylem dokumenty wczoraj, kiedy dostane odpowiedz?
When will I be able to start accepting payments?
Czekam juz jakis czas, jak dlugo to normalnie idzie?

not: What documents do I need to register? (account_register_kyc)
Why is my account blocked? (account_blocked_why)

intents.definition: The user wants to manage team access, roles or add users to the account.
examples: How do I add another user to my account?
Jak nadac ksiegowej dostep tylko do odczytu?
Jak dodac wspolpracownika do panelu?
Chce zeby moj programista widzial klucze, ale nie finanse
Can I set different permission levels for my team?

How do I change my company address? (account_change_data)

intents.definition: The user wants to change their company or account data.
examples: How do I update my company address?

Jak zaktualizowac dane firmy w panelu?
Zmienilismy nazwe spolki, trzeba to gdzies poprawic

No i teraz mam nowy numer NIP, jak to u was pozmieniac?
not: How do I close my account? (account_close)
How do I add a team member? (account_roles_team)

intents.definition: The user wants to close or terminate their merchant account.
examples: How do I close my account?
Chce zrezygnowac z uslugi, jak zamknac konto?
Jak calkowicie usunac konto sprzedawcy?
Nie bede juz tego uzywal, jak sie wypisac?
What happens to my data if I terminate the account?
Zamykam firme, trzeba rozwiazac umowe z wami

not: How do I change my company data? (account_change_data)
Why was my account frozen? (account_blocked_why)

intents.definition: The user wants to report a suspicious email, SMS or a suspected phishing or fraud attempt impersonating kremzaPay.
examples: I got an email asking for my api_key, is it from you?
Dostalem SMS z linkiem do platnosci, wyglada podejrzanie
Czy ten mail o zablokowaniu konta jest od was?

Someone is impersonating kremzaPay in a phishing email, who do I tell?
Przyszla wiadomosc rzekomo od was z prosba o haslo, zglaszam
Halo, jakis oszust podszywa sie pod was, gdzie to zglosic?!
not: My API key actually leaked, what do I do? (security_key_leak)
How do I contact support in general? (support_contact_how)

intents.definition: The user's API keys have been leaked or compromised and they want to know how to respond.
examples: My api_key was committed to a public GitHub repo, what now?
Wyciekl moj crc_key, jak go uniewaznic?
Chyba ktos przechwycil moje klucze API
Przypadkiem wrzucilem klucze do publicznego kodu
How do I rotate my credentials after a possible leak?
Boje sie ze ktos ma dostep do moich kluczy, trzeba je zmienic
O kurde, wystawilem klucze w internecie, ratujcie szybko
not: Where do I find my keys in the panel? (api_keys_where)
I got a suspicious phishing email (security_phishing_report)

intents.definition: The user has a problem with two-factor authentication, a lost device or cannot log in.
examples: I lost my phone and can't get my 2FA code
Jak zresetowac TOTP po zmianie telefonu?
Nie moge sie zalogowac, aplikacja nie generuje kodu
Zmienilem telefon i teraz nie mam dostepu do kodow
My authenticator app was wiped, how do I regain access?
Kody z aplikacji nie dzialaja, ciagle blad logowania
Padl mi telefon z tymi kodami i teraz nie wejde na konto, co robic?
not: Why is my whole account blocked? (account_blocked_why)
My keys leaked, rotate them (security_key_leak)

intents.definition: The user wants to know why their account was blocked or frozen and how to unblock it.
examples: Why is my account frozen all of a sudden?
Konto zablokowane, nie wiem dlaczego
Dlaczego zamrozono moje wyplaty?

How long does activation take? (account_activation_time)

intents.definition: The user wants to know whether the service is down, with payments stuck en masse or the panel not loading.

Cos padlo? Bo nic nie dziala od kilkunastu minut
Ludzie, u was pozar? Bo caly sklep stoi i klienci dzwonia

What are your support hours? (support_contact_how)

intents.definition: The user wants to know how to reach support, its hours or SLA.
examples: How can I contact support?

intents.definition: The user wants to know how to properly report an incident or open a support ticket.

not: How do I contact support and what are the hours? (support_contact_how)
Is there an outage right now? (service_down_question)
